changes: The obsolete vertical brass rule behind the option list is removed.
The approved one-column legal-hand list and all existing state colors are preserved.

assets.usage: opaque panel without the vertical center rule

optionList.overflowRule: Keep one column and scroll; never return to a two-column grid.
optionList.emptySlotRule: Render no placeholder for a missing option.

liveText.rule: No Korean or English label is baked into runtime textures.

guardrails: Use snapshot.LegalPlayerJokerOptions as the only option source.
Keep one column and render no empty placeholders.
Do not restore JokerHandChoice_0_5_9 or JokerHandChoice_0_5_8 as active runtime art.
Keep chooseJokerHand(option.Category) as the immediate action.
Block background input while the modal is open.
Do not change Joker resolution or poker comparison rules.
